jobs.description:
Vontobel hat eine starke Marktposition in der Vermögensverwaltung für Pensionskassen und hat auch das Geschäft für individualisierte Vorsorgelösungen (1e, Kadervorsorge, Freizügigkeit und Säule 3a) in den letzten Jahren erfolgreich entwickelt. Zum weiteren Wachstum unseres Vorsorgegeschäfts suchen wir eine/n abschlussstarke/n und fachlich hervorragend qualifizierte/n Spezialisten/in zur Stärkung unseres Teams in Zürich.

Was sind Deine Aufgaben

• Ansprache und Akquisition von Kunden im Zielsegment der Vorsorgelösungen, n amentlich Führungskräfte, Selbstständigerwerbende und Unternehmer, durch den Vertrieb der 1e-Kadervorsorge-Lösungen der Bank

• Akquisition von Neukunden im Bereich der übrigen Kadervorsorge, der Freizügigkeit und der Säule 3a

• Cross-Selling in verschiedene weitere Bereiche der Bank, insbesondere ins Wealth Management

• Systematische Bearbeitung des Brokermarktes und Aufbau eines Netzes von Vermittlern, Beratern und Intermediären in Ihrer Region

• Beratung von anspruchsvollen Kunden im Bereich sämtlicher Vorsorgelösungen

Was erwarten wir?

• Hervorragende Akquisitions-, Beratungs- und Verhandlungskompetenz

• Starkes Netzwerk von externen Business Partnern

• Fundierte Beratungskompetenz in sämtlichen Themen der Finanz- und Vorsorgeberatung inkl. Pensionskassenthemen, Vorsorgeplanung, Finanzplanung, Steuern, etc.

• Langjährige Erfahrung im Bereich der beruflichen Vorsorge, z.B. bei einem Versicherer oder bei einer Bank

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Vermögensverwaltung und/oder der Anlageberatung

• Akademische Ausbildung mit Abschluss und/oder hochstehende Ausbildungen im Bereich der Finanzplanung oder der beruflichen Vorsorge

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (in Wort und Schrift), Französischkenntnisse von Vorteil

• Unternehmerische, motivierte, teamfähige und gewinnende Persönlichkeit mit souveränem Auftritt, Empathie und der Fähigkeit, die Sprache des Kunden zu sprechen

• Bereitschaft zur kundenbezogenen Reisetätigkeit in der gesamten Deutschschweiz, vor allem im Grossraum Zürich

Was wir bieten:

• Ein hochinteressantes Arbeitsumfeld mit komplexen Fragestellungen, moderner Technologie und einem starken Innovationsfokus.

• Ein dynamisches und internationales Umfeld mit vielen Ideen, das Flexibilität und die kontinuierliche Kalibrierung der Prioritäten erfordert, ohne das langfristige Ziel aus den Augen zu verlieren.

• Die Möglichkeit, Ende-zu-Ende-Perspektiven auf das Client Management zu gewinnen und Prozesse über Abteilungsgrenzen hinweg zu gestalten.

• Hohe Eigenverantwortung und zahlreiche Chancen, Neues zu lernen und Dich weiterzuentwickeln.

Wir suchen nach talentierten Menschen und nicht nur nach einem Lebenslauf, der alle Kriterien erfüllt. Auch wenn du nicht alles mitbringst, was wir von dir verlangen, solltest du dich bewerben.

Bei Vontobel arbeitest du an einer besseren Zukunft für unsere Kunden, die Gesellschaft und dich selbst. Bis 2030 wollen wir als eines der führendsten und vertrauenswürdigsten globalen Investmenthäuser bekannt sein. Wir beschäftigen mehr als 2.300 Mitarbeitende an über 25 Standorten weltweit und haben unseren Hauptsitz in Zürich.
Wir befinden uns mehrheitlich in Familienbesitz und sind börsenkotiert. Unsere Fähigkeit, uns langfristig auf Themen wie Nachhaltigkeit zu konzentrieren, wird durch die Sicherheit des 100-jährigen Engagements der Familie untermauert. Wir suchen diverse Talente, die in einer sich wandelnden Welt etwas bewegen wollen und die aus den unterschiedlichsten Bereichen kommen.

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity.
We value the many voices within our teams and are committed to creating an environme

descriptionByLocale.it:
Vontobel ha una forte posizione di mercato nella gestione degli asset per i fondi pensione e ha anche sviluppato con successo il business per le soluzioni pensionistiche individualizzate (1e, fornitura cadre, libertà di movimento e pilastro 3a) negli ultimi anni. Per l'ulteriore crescita del nostro business pensionistico, stiamo cercando uno specialista forte e altamente qualificato per rafforzare il nostro team a Zurigo.

Quali sono i tuoi compiti

• Affrontare e acquisire i clienti nel segmento target di soluzioni pensionistiche, n amentlich executives, lavoratori autonomi e imprenditori, attraverso la distribuzione delle soluzioni pensionistiche 1e-cade della banca

• Acquisizione di nuovi clienti nel settore di altre forniture cadre, libertà di movimento e pilastro 3a

• Cross-selling in varie altre aree della banca, in particolare nella gestione della ricchezza

• Trattamento sistematico del mercato dei broker e sviluppo di una rete di intermediari, consulenti e intermediari nella vostra regione

• Consulenza clienti esigenti nel settore di tutte le soluzioni pensionistiche

Cosa ci aspettiamo?

• Ottimi capacità di acquisizione, consulenza e negoziazione

• Forte rete di partner commerciali esterni

• Competenze di consulenza sonora in tutti i temi della consulenza finanziaria e pensionistica incl. Argomenti del fondo pensione, pianificazione pensione, pianificazione finanziaria, imposte, ecc.

• Molti anni di esperienza nel settore delle pensioni professionali, ad esempio presso un assicuratore o presso una banca

• Conoscenza approfondita della gestione degli asset e/o consulenza sugli investimenti

• Formazione accademica con formazione di grado e/o di alto livello nella pianificazione finanziaria o nei regimi pensionistici professionali

• Conoscenza molto buona di tedesco e inglese (in parola e scrittura), la conoscenza del francese è vantaggioso

• Entrepreneurial, motivato, team capace e vincente personalità con apparenza sovrana, empatia e la capacità di parlare la lingua del cliente

• Prontezza per i viaggi legati al cliente in tutta la Svizzera tedesca, soprattutto nella zona di Zurigo

Cosa offriamo:

• Un ambiente di lavoro molto interessante con questioni complesse, tecnologia moderna e un forte focus sull'innovazione.

• Un ambiente dinamico e internazionale con molte idee che richiedono flessibilità e calibrazione continua delle priorità senza perdere di vista l'obiettivo a lungo termine.

• L'opportunità di ottenere prospettive end-to-end sulla gestione del cliente e di progettare processi attraverso confini dipartimentali.

• Alta responsabilità personale e numerose opportunità per imparare nuove cose e svilupparsi ulteriormente.

Stiamo cercando persone di talento e non solo un CV che soddisfa tutti i criteri. Anche se non porti tutto quello che ti chiediamo, dovresti applicare.

A Vontobel, stai lavorando ad un futuro migliore per i nostri clienti, la società e te stesso. Entro il 2030, vogliamo essere conosciuti come una delle aziende di investimento globali più importanti e affidabili. Usiamo più di 2.300 persone in più di 25 sedi in tutto il mondo e abbiamo la nostra sede a Zurigo.
Siamo per lo più di proprietà della famiglia e quotati sulla borsa. La nostra capacità di concentrarsi su questioni come la sostenibilità a lungo termine è sostenuta dalla sicurezza dell’impegno di 100 anni della famiglia. Siamo alla ricerca di diversi talenti che vogliono fare la differenza in un mondo mutevole e che provengono da una vasta gamma di campi.

Grazie per aver fatto domanda a Vontobel. Noi esamineremo attentamente la vostra applicazione e vi risponderemo in modo tempestivo.

A Vontobel, siamo un posto di lavoro pari opportunità. Ci impegniamo a pari opportunità di lavoro indipendentemente da razza, colore, antenati, religione, sesso, origine nazionale, orientamento sessuale, età, cittadinanza, stato civile, disabilità o identità di genere.
Valiamo le molte voci all'interno delle nostre squadre e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente
descriptionByLocale.en:
Vontobel has a strong market position in asset management for pension funds and has also successfully developed the business for individualised pension solutions (1e, cadre provision, freedom of movement and pillar 3a) in recent years. For the further growth of our pension business, we are looking for a strong and highly qualified specialist to strengthen our team in Zurich.

What are your tasks

• Addressing and acquiring customers in the target segment of pension solutions, n amentlich executives, self-employed and entrepreneurs, through the distribution of the bank’s 1e-cade pension solutions

• Acquisition of new customers in the area of other cadre provision, freedom of movement and pillar 3a

• Cross-selling in various other areas of the bank, in particular in wealth management

• Systematic processing of the broker market and development of a network of intermediaries, consultants and intermediaries in your region

• Advising demanding customers in the area of all pension solutions

What do we expect?

• Excellent acquisition, consulting and negotiation skills

• Strong network of external business partners

• Sound consulting expertise in all topics of financial and pension consulting incl. Pension fund topics, pension planning, financial planning, taxes, etc.

• Many years of experience in the field of occupational pensions, e.g. at an insurer or at a bank

• In-depth knowledge of asset management and/or investment advice

• Academic training with degree and/or high level training in financial planning or occupational pension schemes

• Very good knowledge of German and English (in word and writing), knowledge of French is advantageous

• Entrepreneurial, motivated, team capable and winning personality with sovereign appearance, empathy and the ability to speak the customer’s language

• Readiness for customer-related travel throughout German-speaking Switzerland, especially in the greater Zurich area

What we offer:

• A highly interesting working environment with complex issues, modern technology and a strong focus on innovation.

• A dynamic and international environment with many ideas that requires flexibility and continuous calibration of priorities without losing sight of the long-term goal.

• The opportunity to gain end-to-end perspectives on client management and to design processes across departmental boundaries.

• High personal responsibility and numerous opportunities to learn new things and develop yourself further.

We are looking for talented people and not just a CV that meets all the criteria. Even if you don’t bring everything we ask of you, you should apply.

At Vontobel, you are working on a better future for our customers, society and yourself. By 2030, we want to be known as one of the most leading and trusted global investment firms. We employ more than 2,300 people at more than 25 locations worldwide and have our headquarters in Zurich.
We are mostly family owned and listed on the stock exchange. Our ability to focus on issues such as sustainability in the long term is underpinned by the safety of the family’s 100-year commitment. We are looking for diverse talents who want to make a difference in a changing world and who come from a wide range of fields.

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity.
We value the many voices within our teams and are committed to creating an environme
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Vontobel a une position forte sur le marché de la gestion d'actifs pour les fonds de pension et a également développé avec succès l'entreprise pour des solutions de retraite individualisées (1e, disposition cadre, libre circulation et pilier 3a) au cours des dernières années. Pour la poursuite de la croissance de notre activité de retraite, nous recherchons un spécialiste fort et hautement qualifié pour renforcer notre équipe à Zurich.

Quelles sont vos tâches

• Adresser et acquérir des clients dans le segment cible des solutions de retraite, n amentlich cadres, indépendants et entrepreneurs, par la distribution de la banque solutions de retraite 1e-cade

• Acquisition de nouveaux clients dans le domaine de la fourniture d'autres cadres, de la libre circulation et du pilier 3a

• Ventes croisées dans divers autres secteurs de la banque, en particulier dans la gestion du patrimoine

• Traitement systématique du marché des courtiers et développement d'un réseau d'intermédiaires, de consultants et d'intermédiaires dans votre région

• Conseiller les clients exigeants dans le domaine de toutes les solutions de retraite

Qu'attendons-nous ?

• Excellentes compétences en acquisition, conseil et négociation

• Un solide réseau de partenaires commerciaux extérieurs

• Une bonne expertise en matière de conseil financier et de conseil en matière de pensions, y compris Sujets des fonds de pension, planification des pensions, planification financière, impôts, etc.

• De nombreuses années d'expérience dans le domaine des pensions professionnelles, par exemple chez un assureur ou une banque

• Connaissance approfondie de la gestion des actifs et/ou des conseils en investissement

• Formation universitaire avec diplôme et/ou formation de haut niveau dans la planification financière ou les régimes de retraite professionnelle

• Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais (en paroles et en écriture), connaissance du français est avantageux

• Entrepreneuriel, motivé, capable d'équipe et gagnant personnalité avec apparence souveraine, empathie et la capacité de parler la langue du client

• Disponibilité pour les voyages liés à la clientèle dans toute la Suisse germanophone, en particulier dans la région de Zurich

Ce que nous offrons:

• Un environnement de travail très intéressant avec des enjeux complexes, une technologie moderne et une forte concentration sur l'innovation.

• Un environnement dynamique et international avec de nombreuses idées qui exigent flexibilité et calibration continue des priorités sans perdre de vue l'objectif à long terme.

• L'occasion d'obtenir des perspectives de bout en bout sur la gestion des clients et de concevoir des processus au-delà des frontières ministérielles.

• Haute responsabilité personnelle et nombreuses occasions d'apprendre de nouvelles choses et de se développer davantage.

Nous cherchons des gens talentueux et pas seulement un CV qui répond à tous les critères. Même si vous n'apportez pas tout ce que nous vous demandons, vous devriez postuler.

Chez Vontobel, vous travaillez sur un avenir meilleur pour nos clients, la société et vous-même. D'ici 2030, nous voulons être connus comme l'une des entreprises d'investissement mondiales les plus importantes et les plus fiables. Nous employons plus de 2300 personnes dans plus de 25 sites dans le monde et avons notre siège à Zurich.
Nous sommes pour la plupart la propriété familiale et cotés en bourse. Notre capacité à se concentrer sur des questions telles que la durabilité à long terme est étayée par la sécurité de la famille. Nous recherchons des talents divers qui veulent faire la différence dans un monde en évolution et qui viennent d'un large éventail de domaines.

Merci d'avoir postulé à Vontobel. Nous examinerons attentivement votre demande et vous répondrons en temps opportun.

À Vontobel, nous sommes un lieu de travail à égalité des chances. Nous sommes attachés à l'égalité des chances en matière d'emploi, indépendamment de la race, de la couleur, de l'ascendance, de la religion, du sexe, de l'origine nationale, de l'orientation sexuelle, de l'âge, de la citoyenneté, de l'état matrimonial, du handicap ou de l'identité de genre.
Nous apprécions les nombreuses voix au sein de nos équipes et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement

jobs.title: Senior Relationship Manager EAM UK (100%)
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about the financial world and do you enjoy building and maintaining long-lasting relationships with clients? Our EAM desk covering the United Kingdom is looking for a Relationship Manager to join their team.

What would your role be?

• Development of the United Kingdom as B2B market for Bank Vontobel

• Take over an existing client portfolio

• Develop new client connections, bring in existing own client relationships, and be responsible for acquiring new business from with a focus on the United Kingdom

• Act as a trusted advisor to clients and prospects by providing recommendations that encompass multiple products and services

• Develop in-depth understanding of client’s needs, preferences and overall wealth and be responsive to the changes in the business environment or clients’ needs

• Effectively manage your book of clients and act as a relationship lead accountable for the clients’ experience

• Leverage specialists, service officers and other expert resources to ensure the integrated delivery of investment fiduciary, credit, and banking solutions

What are we looking for?

• An Education in the field of finance or economics

• At least five years of experience as a Relationship Manager (experience supporting external asset managers (EAM) is an asset)

• A good network of potential of multifamily offices and financial intermediaries in the United Kingdom

• A client-focused individual with exceptional interpersonal skills, high motivation and entrepreneurial spirit

• Solution-oriented and considerable sales and financial aptitude

• Pro-active, analytical, and structured

• Fluent in German, English

What do we offer?

• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces (including rooftop terraces) and free lunch.

• Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space.

• All the latest technology to help you excel and advance.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels.

• Campus feeling and a collaborative spirit.

Why Vontobel?
At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 28 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich, we’re committed to long-term thinking and sustainability.
Our diverse team values unique perspectives, and we hire individuals determined to deliver in a dynamic and changing world. Even if you don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply if you’re enthusiastic about the role.
Do you want to be Vontobel?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity.
We value the many voices within our teams and are committed to creating an environment where everyone who wants to be part of our performance culture can be themselves. It is based on mutual respect and zero tolerance for any form of discrimination.

If you have any questions you can contact us through our contact form .

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei appassionato del mondo finanziario e ti piace costruire e mantenere relazioni durature con i clienti? La nostra scrivania EAM che copre il Regno Unito sta cercando un Relationship Manager per unirsi alla loro squadra.

Qual è il tuo ruolo?

• Sviluppo del Regno Unito come mercato B2B per la Banca Vontobel

• Assumere un portafoglio client esistente

• Sviluppare nuove connessioni client, portare in relazioni con i propri clienti esistenti, e essere responsabile per l'acquisizione di nuove attività da con un focus sul Regno Unito

• Agire come consulente affidabile per i clienti e le prospettive fornendo raccomandazioni che comprendono più prodotti e servizi

• Sviluppare una comprensione approfondita delle esigenze, delle preferenze e della ricchezza complessiva del cliente e rispondere ai cambiamenti nell’ambiente aziendale o alle esigenze dei clienti

• Efficacemente gestire il tuo libro dei clienti e agire come un rapporto responsabile per l'esperienza dei clienti

• Specialisti di levaggio, agenti di servizio e altre risorse di esperti per garantire la fornitura integrata di soluzioni fiduciarie, di credito e bancarie

Cosa stiamo cercando?

• Una formazione nel campo della finanza o dell'economia

• Almeno cinque anni di esperienza come Relationship Manager (l'esperienza che supporta gli asset manager esterni (EAM) è un bene)

• Una buona rete di potenziali uffici multifamiliari e intermediari finanziari nel Regno Unito

• Un individuo orientato al cliente con eccezionali competenze interpersonali, elevata motivazione e spirito imprenditoriale

• Affidabilità finanziaria e commerciale orientata alla soluzione

• Proattivo, analitico e strutturato

• Fluente in tedesco, inglese

Cosa offriamo?

• Posizione top a Zurigo con spazi di collaborazione (tra cui terrazze sul tetto) e pranzo gratuito.

• Un team amichevole e diversificato in uno spazio aperto.

• Tutte le ultime tecnologie per aiutarti ad eccellere e avanzare.

• Ambiente aggressivo in come pensiamo, il modo in cui lavoriamo e la nostra fiducia l'uno per l'altro.

• Gerarchia piatta con collaborazione a tutti i livelli.

• Il sentimento del campus e lo spirito collaborativo.

jobs.title: Expert IT Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about IT security and ready to take on exciting challenges in a dynamic environment? We are seeking a skilled and versatile Senior IT Security Engineer to join our Security Engineering team in Zurich. In this role, you will play a key part in ensuring our platforms meet the highest security standards while driving the successful implementation of innovative IT security projects.

What would your role be?

• Design, plan, procure, install, and configure new IT security solutions, as well as optimize the existing IT security infrastructure.

• Act as an IAM expert by securing our access infrastructure, optimizing authentication flows, and ensuring seamless integration of various business applications.

• Lead IT security infrastructure projects.

• Take application ownership for IT security platforms, including operations, monitoring, 3rd-level support, and on-call duty.

• Further develop IT security architecture and create corresponding concepts and standards.

• Advise and support system and application owners, as well as internal or external project managers, on IT security topics.

What are we looking for?

• Extensive technical expertise in the Ping Identity platform (formerly ForgeRock) is essential.

• Degree from a higher education institution (e.g. university, technical university, or university of applied sciences) in computer science or an equivalent qualification with a focus on IT.

• Additional training or certifications in IT security (e.g. CAS IS/MAS IS, CISSP, CISA).

• Demonstrated experience as a software developer specializing in IT security.

• Broad IT security expertise and hands-on experience in implementing multiple projects.

• Strong general IT application and infrastructure knowledge, as well as project management experience, preferably in the financial sector.

• Excellent conceptual, analytical, and communication skills.

• Fluency in both German and English.

What do we offer?

• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces (including rooftop terraces) and free lunch.

• Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space.

• All the latest technology to help you excel and advance.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels.

• Campus feeling and a collaborative spirit.

Why Vontobel?
At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 28 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich, we’re committed to long-term thinking and sustainability.
Our diverse team values unique perspectives, and we hire individuals determined to deliver in a dynamic and changing world. Even if you don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply if you’re enthusiastic about the role.
Do you want to be Vontobel?

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity.
We value the many voices within our teams and are committed to creating an environment where everyone who wants to be part of our performance culture can be themselves. It is based on mutual respect and zero tolerance for any form of discrimination.

If you have any questions you can contact us through our contact form .

jobs.title: Senior AI Architect (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At Vontobel, AI is moving beyond pilots.
We are building production-grade, regulated, and scalable AI systems — and we are looking for the architecture leader who sets the technical direction behind them.
As Senior AI Architect, you own the AI architecture across the firm: from LLM- and agent-based solutions to the enterprise platforms, guardrails, and standards that make them work in production.

What would your role be?

• Define, own, and continuously evolve the enterprise AI architecture and lead hands-on delivery of production-grade AI solutions end-to-end.

• Design and build LLM- and agent-based AI systems

• Establish and apply hands-on best practices for LLM and RAG architectures

• Architect scalable, secure, and resilient AI platforms, leveraging distributed and event-driven architectures

• Act as a hands-on architecture leader, mentoring senior engineers, leading architecture and design reviews, and delivering production-ready prototypes and reference implementations.

• Work closely with Product, Security, Risk, Legal/Compliance, and IT, ensuring AI solutions meet regulatory, governance, and model-risk requirements, while leading the AI Developer Guild to raise engineering standards and capability across the organization.

What are we looking for?

• A hands-on senior AI architecture leader, not a purely strategic person with deep engineering experience (8+ years in software engineering), including several years in architecture or technical leadership roles delivering production-grade AI / LLM solutions.

• Strong backend and systems engineering expertise, with deep hands-on experience in Python and modern API/service development

• Practical experience engineering LLM-powered applications, including LLMs, RAG, and agent-based patterns

• Solid MLOps and AI platform engineering background, covering model and prompt lifecycle management, offline and online evaluation, drift detection, reproducibility, and auditability of AI systems.

• Proven DevOps and cloud architecture experience, including CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, container platforms (Kubernetes/OpenShift), observability, and secure cloud-native architectures (preferably Azure).

• Comfort working in regulated, enterprise environments, balancing speed, quality, and risk while collaborating closely with Security, Risk, Compliance, and IT stakeholders.

• A pragmatic, communicative leader and mentor, comfortable owning decisions, navigating ambiguity, influencing multiple teams, and continuously raising the technical bar; fluent in English, with German as a strong plus.

What do we offer?

• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces and free lunch.

• All the latest technology to help you excel and advance.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels.

• Campus feeling and a collaborative spirit.

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

Why Vontobel?
At Vontobel, you are building better futures for our clients and society, as well as for yourself. As a family-owned and publicly listed company with over 2,000 professionals based in 28 locations globally and headquartered in Zurich, we’re committed to long-term thinking and sustainability.
Our diverse team values unique perspectives, and we hire individuals determined to deliver in a dynamic and changing world. Even if you don’t meet all the criteria, we encourage you to apply if you’re enthusiastic about the role.

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship,

descriptionByLocale.it:
A Vontobel, l'IA si sta muovendo oltre i piloti.
Stiamo costruendo sistemi AI di livello produttivo, regolamentati e scalabili, e stiamo cercando il leader dell'architettura che imposta la direzione tecnica dietro di loro.
Come Senior AI Architect, possiedi l'architettura AI in tutta l'azienda: dalle soluzioni basate su LLM alle piattaforme aziendali, ai guardrails e agli standard che li rendono lavorare in produzione.

Qual è il tuo ruolo?

• Definire, propri e evolvere continuamente l'architettura AI aziendale e portare la consegna manuale di soluzioni AI di livello di produzione end-to-end.

• Progettazione e costruzione di sistemi AI LLM- e basati su agenti

• Stabilire e applicare le migliori pratiche pratiche per le architetture LLM e RAG

• Architetto piattaforme AI scalabili, sicure e resistenti, sfruttando architetture distribuite e orientate agli eventi

• Agire come leader di architettura pratico, mentoring ingegneri senior, principali recensioni di architettura e design, e fornire prototipi pronti per la produzione e implementazioni di riferimento.

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con Prodotto, Sicurezza, Rischio, Legale/Compliance e IT, assicurando che le soluzioni AI soddisfino i requisiti normativi, di governance e di modello-rischio, mentre guida l'AI Developer Guild per aumentare gli standard di ingegneria e la capacità in tutta l'organizzazione.

Cosa stiamo cercando?

• Leader dell'architettura AI, non una persona puramente strategica con una profonda esperienza di ingegneria (8+ anni in ingegneria del software), tra cui diversi anni in architettura o ruoli di leadership tecnica che forniscono soluzioni AI / LLM di livello produttivo.

• Forte esperienza di backend e ingegneria dei sistemi, con profonda esperienza pratica in Python e sviluppo moderno API/service

• Pratica esperienza di ingegneria applicazioni alimentate a LLM, tra cui LLM, RAG e modelli basati su agenti

• Solid MLOps e AI piattaforma di ingegneria background, che copre il modello e la gestione del ciclo di vita rapida, la valutazione offline e online, il rilevamento della deriva, la riproducibilità e l'auditability dei sistemi AI.

• Provata esperienza DevOps e architettura cloud, tra cui CI/CD, infrastruttura-as-code, piattaforme container (Kubernetes/OpenShift), osservabilità e architetture cloud-native sicure (preferibilmente Azure).

• Comfort lavorando in ambienti regolamentati, aziendali, bilanciando velocità, qualità e rischio, collaborando a stretto contatto con le parti interessate di Sicurezza, Rischio, Compliance e IT.

• Un leader e mentore pragmatico, comunicativo, decisioni di gestione confortevoli, navigando ambiguità, influenzando più squadre, e continuamente alzando la barra tecnica; fluente in inglese, con il tedesco come un vantaggio forte.

Cosa offriamo?

• Posizione top a Zurigo con spazi di collaborazione e pranzo gratuito.

• Tutte le ultime tecnologie per aiutarti ad eccellere e avanzare.

• Ambiente aggressivo in come pensiamo, il modo in cui lavoriamo e la nostra fiducia l'uno per l'altro.

• Gerarchia piatta con collaborazione a tutti i livelli.

• Il sentimento del campus e lo spirito collaborativo.

Stiamo cercando persone di talento, non solo un CV che ticchetta tutte le scatole. Anche se non avete assolutamente tutto quello che abbiamo chiesto, se questo ruolo suona come una buona misura per voi, vi incoraggiamo ad applicare.

Perché Vontobel?
A Vontobel, stai costruendo un futuro migliore per i nostri clienti e la società, così come per te. Come azienda di proprietà familiare e quotata in pubblico con oltre 2.000 professionisti con sede in 28 sedi a livello globale e con sede a Zurigo, ci impegniamo a pensare e sostenibilità a lungo termine.
Il nostro team diversificato valorizza prospettive uniche, e assumere individui determinati a fornire in un mondo dinamico e mutevole. Anche se non soddisfate tutti i criteri, vi incoraggiamo ad applicare se siete entusiasti del ruolo.

Grazie per aver fatto domanda a Vontobel. Noi esamineremo attentamente la vostra applicazione e vi risponderemo in modo tempestivo.

A Vontobel, siamo un posto di lavoro pari opportunità. Ci impegniamo a pari opportunità di lavoro indipendentemente da razza, colore, antenati, religione, sesso, origine nazionale, orientamento sessuale, età, cittadinanza,
descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Vontobel geht KI über Piloten hinaus.
Wir bauen produktionsgerechte, regulierte und skalierbare KI-Systeme - und wir suchen den Architekturführer, der die technische Richtung dahinter setzt.
Als Senior AI Architect besitzen Sie die KI-Architektur im gesamten Unternehmen: von LLM- und agentenbasierten Lösungen bis hin zu Unternehmensplattformen, Leitplanken und Standards, die sie in der Produktion arbeiten lassen.

Was wäre Ihre Rolle?

• Definieren, besitzen und entwickeln Sie die Enterprise AI-Architektur kontinuierlich weiter und führen Sie die praktische Bereitstellung von KI-Lösungen in Produktionsqualität durchgängig.

• Entwerfen und bauen Sie LLM- und agentenbasierte KI-Systeme

• Etablieren und Anwenden von praktischen Best Practices für LLM- und RAG-Architekturen

• Architektur skalierbare, sichere und belastbare KI-Plattformen, die verteilte und ereignisgesteuerte Architekturen nutzen

• Handeln Sie als praktischer Architekturführer, betreuen Sie leitende Ingenieure, leiten Sie Architektur- und Designüberprüfungen und liefern Sie produktionsfähige Prototypen und Referenzimplementierungen.

• Arbeiten Sie eng mit Produkt, Sicherheit, Risiko, Recht / Compliance und IT zusammen und stellen Sie sicher, dass KI-Lösungen die regulatorischen, Governance- und Modellrisikoanforderungen erfüllen, während Sie die AI Developer Guild dazu bringen, die Engineering-Standards und -Fähigkeiten im gesamten Unternehmen zu erhöhen.

Worauf warten wir?

• Ein erfahrener KI-Architekturführer, keine rein strategische Person mit fundierter Engineering-Erfahrung (8+ Jahre im Software-Engineering), einschließlich mehrerer Jahre in Architektur- oder technischen Führungspositionen, die AI / LLM-Lösungen in Produktionsqualität liefern.

• Starkes Backend- und System-Engineering-Know-how mit umfassender praktischer Erfahrung in Python und moderner API/Service-Entwicklung

• Praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von LLM-basierten Anwendungen, einschließlich LLMs, RAGs und agentenbasierten Mustern

• Solider MLOps- und AI-Plattform-Engineering-Hintergrund, der das Modell- und prompte Lebenszyklusmanagement, die Offline- und Online-Evaluierung, Drifterkennung, Reproduzierbarkeit und Auditierbarkeit von KI-Systemen umfasst.

• Bewährte DevOps- und Cloud-Architektur-Erfahrung, einschließlich CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code, Containerplattformen (Kubernetes/OpenShift), Beobachtbarkeit und sichere Cloud-native Architekturen (vorzugsweise Azure).

• Komfort beim Arbeiten in regulierten Unternehmensumgebungen, beim Ausgleich von Geschwindigkeit, Qualität und Risiko bei enger Zusammenarbeit mit Security-, Risk-, Compliance- und IT-Stakeholdern.

• Eine pragmatische, kommunikative Führungskraft und Mentorin, die es sich bequem macht, Entscheidungen zu treffen, Mehrdeutigkeiten zu navigieren, mehrere Teams zu beeinflussen und die technische Messlatte kontinuierlich zu erhöhen; fließend Englisch, mit Deutsch als starkem Plus.

Was bieten wir an?

• Top Zürich Lage mit Collaboration Spaces und kostenlosem Mittagessen.

• Die neueste Technologie, die Ihnen hilft, sich zu profilieren und weiterzuentwickeln.

• Agile Umgebung, wie wir denken, wie wir arbeiten und unser Vertrauen füreinander.

• Flache Hierarchie mit Zusammenarbeit auf allen Ebenen.

• Campus-Gefühl und ein kooperativer Geist.

Wir suchen talentierte Leute, nicht nur einen Lebenslauf, der alle Kästchen ankreuzt. Auch wenn Sie nicht absolut alles haben, wonach wir gefragt haben, wenn diese Rolle nach einer guten Passform für Sie klingt, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich zu bewerben.

Warum Vontobel?
Bei Vontobel bauen Sie eine bessere Zukunft für unsere Kunden und die Gesellschaft sowie für sich selbst. Als familiengeführtes und börsennotiertes Unternehmen mit über 2.000 Fachleuten an 28 Standorten weltweit mit Hauptsitz in Zürich setzen wir auf langfristiges Denken und Nachhaltigkeit.
Unser vielfältiges Team schätzt einzigartige Perspektiven und wir stellen Einzelpersonen ein, die entschlossen sind, in einer dynamischen und sich verändernden Welt zu liefern. Auch wenn Sie nicht alle Kriterien erfüllen, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich zu bewerben, wenn Sie von der Rolle begeistert sind.

Vielen Dank, dass Sie sich bei Vontobel bewerben. Wir werden Ihre Bewerbung sorgfältig prüfen und Ihnen rechtzeitig antworten.

Bei Vontobel sind wir ein Chancengleichheitsarbeitsplatz. Wir setzen uns für gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten ein, unabhängig von Rasse, Hautfarbe, Abstammung, Religion, Geschlecht, nationaler Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Staatsangehörigkeit,

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy the idea of playing a pivotal role in the success of a key function of a global investment house?

In this role, we are looking for an organized and reliable Executive Assistant who will support the Head Investments and will have direct exposure to international business situations and to a wide range of counterparts.

Please note this is a 100% role due to workload required.

What would your role be?

• Independently and professionally manage the secretariat of the Head Investments and support him in his day-to-day business by thinking independently and with foresight.

• Manage the demanding agenda with overview and care, taking minutes during meetings but also planning and coordinating internal and external meetings, townhalls, offsite workshops, and other special events and ensuring structured and timely follow-ups.

• Support selected Business Management tasks beyond the classic Executive Assistant role (e.g. creating strategic management documents and presentations, consolidation of financial data from various stakeholders etc.)

• Manage other general administrative tasks (e.g. checking and allocating invoices, accepting expenses) efficiently and critically and plan and coordinate business trips, including booking of hotels, flights, restaurants and meetings.

• Handle internal and external correspondence in German and English on a high professional level.

• Act as a trusted point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, always ensuring professional representation of the Head Investments.

What are we looking for?

• Similar experience, preferably within an international company in the financial industry (Asset Management, Investment Banking, Private Banking, Insurance).

• Minimum of 3 years’ experience as an executive assistant

• Excellent organizational and prioritization skills with the ability to manage a demanding agenda

• High level of discretion, reliability and a service-oriented mindset

• Ability to provide support for Business Management tasks

• Commercial training or similar, ideally supplemented by further training as an executive assistant and/or assistant; a bachelor’s degree is a plus.

• Excellent MS Office skills (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook) and familiarity with modern communication tools.

• Excellent written and spoken German and English skills and the ability to communicate with stakeholders on all seniority levels are a must.

• Experience working in a fast-paced environment.

What do we offer?

• Top Zurich location with collaboration spaces (including rooftop terraces) and free lunch.

• Friendly, diverse team in an open-office space.

• All the latest technology to help you excel and advance.

• Agile environment in how we think, the way we work and our trust for each other.

• Flat hierarchy with collaboration at all levels.

• Campus feeling and a collaborative spirit.

We are looking for talented people, not just a CV that ticks all the boxes. Even if you do not have absolutely everything we have asked for, if this role sounds like a good fit for you, we encourage you to apply.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ti piace l'idea di giocare un ruolo fondamentale nel successo di una funzione chiave di una casa di investimento globale?

In questo ruolo, stiamo cercando un Executive Assistant organizzato e affidabile che supporterà i Head Investments e avrà un'esposizione diretta a situazioni di business internazionali e ad una vasta gamma di controparti.

Si prega di notare che questo è un ruolo al 100% a causa del carico di lavoro richiesto.

Qual è il tuo ruolo?

• Indipendentemente e professionalmente gestire il segretariato del capo Investimenti e supportarlo nella sua attività quotidiana pensando in modo indipendente e con vista.

• Gestire l'agenda esigente con la panoramica e la cura, prendendo minuti durante le riunioni, ma anche progettando e coordinando incontri interni ed esterni, centri abitati, officine offsite, e altri eventi speciali e garantendo follow-up strutturati e tempestivi.

• Supporta i compiti di Business Management selezionati oltre il classico ruolo di Executive Assistant (ad esempio la creazione di documenti e presentazioni strategici di gestione, il consolidamento dei dati finanziari da vari stakeholder, ecc.)

• Gestire altri compiti amministrativi generali (ad esempio il controllo e l'assegnazione delle fatture, l'accettazione delle spese) in modo efficiente e critico e pianificare e coordinare viaggi d'affari, compresa la prenotazione di hotel, voli, ristoranti e riunioni.

• Gestire la corrispondenza interna ed esterna in tedesco e inglese ad alto livello professionale.

• Agire come punto di contatto affidabile per gli stakeholder interni ed esterni, garantendo sempre la rappresentanza professionale dei Head Investments.

Cosa stiamo cercando?

• Esperienza simile, preferibilmente all'interno di una società internazionale nel settore finanziario (Asset Management, Investment Banking, Private Banking, Assicurazione).

• Esperienza minima di 3 anni come assistente esecutivo

• Eccellente capacità organizzativa e di priorità con la capacità di gestire un'agenda impegnativa

• Alto livello di discrezione, affidabilità e mentalità orientata al servizio

• Capacità di fornire supporto per le attività di Business Management

• Formazione commerciale o simile, idealmente completato da ulteriore formazione come assistente esecutivo e / o assistente; un diploma di laurea è un plus.

• Competenze di MS Office eccellenti (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook) e familiarità con strumenti di comunicazione moderni.

• Le eccellenti competenze scritte e parlate in tedesco e inglese e la capacità di comunicare con gli stakeholder su tutti i livelli di anzianità sono un must.

• Esperienza di lavoro in un ambiente frenetico.

Cosa offriamo?

• Posizione top a Zurigo con spazi di collaborazione (tra cui terrazze sul tetto) e pranzo gratuito.

• Un team amichevole e diversificato in uno spazio aperto.

• Tutte le ultime tecnologie per aiutarti ad eccellere e avanzare.

• Ambiente aggressivo in come pensiamo, il modo in cui lavoriamo e la nostra fiducia l'uno per l'altro.

• Gerarchia piatta con collaborazione a tutti i livelli.

• Il sentimento del campus e lo spirito collaborativo.

Stiamo cercando persone di talento, non solo un CV che ticchetta tutte le scatole. Anche se non avete assolutamente tutto quello che abbiamo chiesto, se questo ruolo suona come una buona misura per voi, vi incoraggiamo ad applicare.

Perché Vontobel?
A Vontobel, stai costruendo un futuro migliore per i nostri clienti e la società, così come per te. Come azienda di proprietà familiare e quotata in pubblico con oltre 2.000 professionisti con sede in 28 sedi a livello globale e con sede a Zurigo, ci impegniamo a pensare e sostenibilità a lungo termine.

Il nostro team diversificato valorizza prospettive uniche, e assumere individui determinati a fornire in un mondo dinamico e mutevole. Anche se non soddisfate tutti i criteri, vi incoraggiamo ad applicare se siete entusiasti del ruolo.
Vuoi essere Vontobel?

Grazie per aver fatto domanda a Vontobel. Noi esamineremo attentamente la vostra applicazione e vi risponderemo in modo tempestivo.

A Vontobel, siamo un posto di lavoro pari opportunità. Ci impegniamo a pari opportunità di lavoro indipendentemente da razza, colore, antenati, religione, sesso, origine nazionale, orientamento sessuale, età, cittadinanza,
descriptionByLocale.de:
Gefällt Ihnen die Idee, eine zentrale Rolle für den Erfolg einer Schlüsselfunktion eines globalen Investmenthauses zu spielen?

In dieser Funktion suchen wir einen organisierten und zuverlässigen Executive Assistant, der den Head Investments unterstützt und direkt mit internationalen Geschäftssituationen und einer Vielzahl von Pendants in Berührung kommt.

Bitte beachten Sie, dass dies eine 100% ige Rolle aufgrund der erforderlichen Arbeitsbelastung ist.

Was wäre Ihre Rolle?

• Führen Sie selbstständig und professionell das Sekretariat des Head Investments und unterstützen Sie ihn in seinem Tagesgeschäft, indem Sie unabhängig und vorausschauend denken.

• Verwalten Sie die anspruchsvolle Agenda mit Überblick und Sorgfalt, nehmen Sie sich während der Besprechungen Minuten, planen und koordinieren Sie aber auch interne und externe Besprechungen, Rathäuser, Offsite-Workshops und andere besondere Veranstaltungen und gewährleisten Sie strukturierte und zeitnahe Folgemaßnahmen.

• Unterstützung ausgewählter Business Management-Aufgaben über die klassische Rolle des Executive Assistant hinaus (z.B. Erstellung strategischer Managementdokumente und Präsentationen, Konsolidierung von Finanzdaten verschiedener Stakeholder etc.)

• Verwalten Sie andere allgemeine Verwaltungsaufgaben (z. B. Überprüfung und Zuweisung von Rechnungen, Annahme von Kosten) effizient und kritisch und planen und koordinieren Sie Geschäftsreisen, einschließlich der Buchung von Hotels, Flügen, Restaurants und Meetings.

• Behandeln Sie interne und externe Korrespondenz in Deutsch und Englisch auf hohem fachlichem Niveau.

• Handeln Sie als vertrauenswürdiger Ansprechpartner für interne und externe Stakeholder und gewährleisten Sie stets eine professionelle Vertretung des Head Investments.

Worauf warten wir?

• Ähnliche Erfahrungen, vorzugsweise innerhalb eines internationalen Unternehmens in der Finanzbranche (Asset Management, Investment Banking, Private Banking, Insurance).

• Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung als Executive Assistant

• Hervorragende organisatorische und Priorisierung Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, eine anspruchsvolle Agenda zu verwalten

• Hohe Diskretion, Zuverlässigkeit und ein serviceorientiertes Mindset

• Fähigkeit zur Unterstützung von Business Management-Aufgaben

• kaufmännische Ausbildung oder ähnliches, idealerweise ergänzt durch eine Weiterbildung zum Executive Assistant und/oder Assistant; ein Bachelorabschluss ist ein Plus.

• Ausgezeichnete MS Office Fähigkeiten (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook) und Vertrautheit mit modernen Kommunikations-Tools.

• Hervorragende schriftliche und gesprochene Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse und die Fähigkeit, mit Stakeholdern auf allen Führungsebenen zu kommunizieren, sind ein Muss.

• Erfahrung in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung.

Was bieten wir an?

• Top Zürich Lage mit Collaboration Spaces (einschließlich Dachterrassen) und kostenlosem Mittagessen.

• Freundliches, vielfältiges Team in einem Open-Office-Bereich.

• Die neueste Technologie, die Ihnen hilft, sich zu profilieren und weiterzuentwickeln.

• Agile Umgebung, wie wir denken, wie wir arbeiten und unser Vertrauen füreinander.

• Flache Hierarchie mit Zusammenarbeit auf allen Ebenen.

• Campus-Gefühl und ein kooperativer Geist.

Wir suchen talentierte Leute, nicht nur einen Lebenslauf, der alle Kästchen ankreuzt. Auch wenn Sie nicht absolut alles haben, wonach wir gefragt haben, wenn diese Rolle nach einer guten Passform für Sie klingt, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich zu bewerben.

Warum Vontobel?
Bei Vontobel bauen Sie eine bessere Zukunft für unsere Kunden und die Gesellschaft sowie für sich selbst. Als familiengeführtes und börsennotiertes Unternehmen mit über 2.000 Fachleuten an 28 Standorten weltweit mit Hauptsitz in Zürich setzen wir auf langfristiges Denken und Nachhaltigkeit.

Unser vielfältiges Team schätzt einzigartige Perspektiven und wir stellen Einzelpersonen ein, die entschlossen sind, in einer dynamischen und sich verändernden Welt zu liefern. Auch wenn Sie nicht alle Kriterien erfüllen, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich zu bewerben, wenn Sie von der Rolle begeistert sind.
Wollen Sie Vontobel sein?

Vielen Dank, dass Sie sich bei Vontobel bewerben. Wir werden Ihre Bewerbung sorgfältig prüfen und Ihnen rechtzeitig antworten.

Bei Vontobel sind wir ein Chancengleichheitsarbeitsplatz. Wir setzen uns für gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten ein, unabhängig von Rasse, Hautfarbe, Abstammung, Religion, Geschlecht, nationaler Herkunft, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Staatsangehörigkeit,
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Appréciez-vous l'idée de jouer un rôle central dans le succès d'une fonction clé d'une maison d'investissement mondiale?

Dans ce rôle, nous sommes à la recherche d'un adjoint exécutif organisé et fiable qui appuiera les investissements de Head et sera directement exposé aux situations d'affaires internationales et à un large éventail de contreparties.

Veuillez noter que ce rôle est de 100 % en raison de la charge de travail requise.

Quel serait votre rôle ?

• Gérer de manière indépendante et professionnelle le secrétariat de Head Investments et le soutenir dans ses activités quotidiennes en pensant de manière indépendante et avec prévoyance.

• Gérer l'ordre du jour exigeant avec vue d'ensemble et soin, en prenant des procès-verbaux lors de réunions mais aussi en planifiant et en coordonnant des réunions internes et externes, des mairies, des ateliers hors site et d'autres événements spéciaux et en assurant un suivi structuré et opportun.

• Soutenir certaines tâches de gestion d'entreprise au-delà du rôle classique d'adjoint à la direction (p. ex. création de documents de gestion stratégique et de présentations, regroupement des données financières de divers intervenants, etc.)

• Gérer d'autres tâches administratives générales (vérifier et répartir les factures, accepter les dépenses) de manière efficace et critique et planifier et coordonner les voyages d'affaires, y compris la réservation d'hôtels, de vols, de restaurants et de réunions.

• Gérer la correspondance interne et externe en allemand et en anglais sur un haut niveau professionnel.

• Agir en tant que point de contact de confiance pour les parties prenantes internes et externes, en assurant toujours la représentation professionnelle de Head Investments.

Qu'est-ce qu'on cherche ?

• Expérience similaire, de préférence au sein d'une entreprise internationale du secteur financier (Asset Management, Investment Banking, Private Banking, Insurance).

• Minimum de 3 ans d'expérience comme assistant exécutif

• Excellentes compétences organisationnelles et hiérarchisées avec la capacité de gérer un programme exigeant

• Un haut niveau de discrétion, de fiabilité et un état d'esprit orienté vers le service

• Aptitude à soutenir les tâches de gestion d'entreprise

• Formation commerciale ou similaire, idéalement complétée par une formation continue en tant qu'assistant exécutif et/ou assistant; un baccalauréat est un plus.

• Excellentes compétences MS Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook) et la familiarité avec les outils de communication modernes.

• Excellentes compétences écrites et parlées en allemand et en anglais et la capacité de communiquer avec les parties prenantes à tous les niveaux d'ancienneté sont un must.

• Expérience de travail dans un environnement rapide.

Qu'est-ce qu'on offre ?

• Haut de Zurich avec des espaces de collaboration (y compris des terrasses sur le toit) et déjeuner gratuit.

• Équipe amicale et diversifiée dans un espace ouvert.

• Toutes les dernières technologies pour vous aider à exceller et à progresser.

• Environnement agile dans notre façon de penser, notre façon de travailler et notre confiance les uns pour les autres.

• Hiérarchie plate avec collaboration à tous les niveaux.

• Sensation de campus et esprit de collaboration.

Nous cherchons des gens talentueux, pas seulement un CV qui coche toutes les boîtes. Même si vous n'avez pas absolument tout ce que nous avons demandé, si ce rôle vous semble bon, nous vous encourageons à postuler.

Pourquoi Vontobel ?
Chez Vontobel, vous construisez de meilleurs avenirs pour nos clients et notre société, ainsi que pour vous-même. En tant qu'entreprise familiale et cotée en bourse avec plus de 2 000 professionnels basés sur 28 sites à l'échelle mondiale et ayant son siège à Zurich, nous sommes engagés dans la pensée et la durabilité à long terme.

Notre équipe diversifiée valorise des perspectives uniques, et nous embauchons des individus déterminés à livrer dans un monde dynamique et changeant. Même si vous ne répondez pas à tous les critères, nous vous encourageons à postuler si vous êtes enthousiaste au sujet du rôle.
Tu veux être Vontobel ?

Merci d'avoir postulé à Vontobel. Nous examinerons attentivement votre demande et vous répondrons en temps opportun.

À Vontobel, nous sommes un lieu de travail à égalité des chances. Nous nous engageons à l'égalité des chances en matière d'emploi, sans distinction de race, de couleur, d'ascendance, de religion, de sexe, d'origine nationale, d'orientation sexuelle, d'âge, de citoyenneté,

jobs.description:
Wir suchen eine engagierte, analytische und gestaltungsorientierte Persönlichkeit, die gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft des Cross-Border-Managements aktiv weiterentwickelt. Wenn du gerne Verantwortung übernimmst, komplexe Fragestellungen strukturierst und in einem internationalen Umfeld echten Impact erzielen möchtest, bist Du bei uns genau richtig!

Was sind Deine Aufgaben:

• Sicherstellung sowie kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung eines ganzheitlichen, und wirkungsvollen Cross-Border Frameworks (inkl. Methoden, Prozesse und Reporting, unter gezielten Einsatz von Automatisierung und KI-Technologien

• Verantwortung für die Planung, Koordination und Implementierung von anspruchsvollen Cross-Border-Projekten mit hoher Sichtbarkeit

• Zentrale Fachstelle für Cross-Border Fragestellungen: Beratung, Koordination und enge Zusammenarbeit mit Relationship Manager, Sparring Partner für Market Heads und Senior Management

• Analyse, Erarbeitung und Weiterentwicklung von Cross-Border relevanten Richtlinien, Entscheidungsgrundlagen und Reports unter Einbezug von KI-gestützter Analyse- und Reportingtools

• Aktive Mitgestaltung und Weiterentwicklung von Cross-Border-Governance, Prozess- und Operating-Modellen

• Mitarbeit und inhaltliche Unterstützung bei internen Audits sowie regulatorischen Prüfungen

Was erwarten wir?

• Abgeschlossenes Hoch- oder Fachhochschulstudium (Wirtschaft, Recht, Finance oder vergleichbar)

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Cross-Border in der Finanzbranche, zwingend in der «First Line of Defense» im Private Clients Umfeld, Beratungserfahrung ist ein Plus

• Fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich Projekt- und Stakeholdermanagement kombiniert mit ausgezeichneter Kommunikationsfähigkeit in Deutsch und Englisch

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse der (Front-)Kernprozesse einer Bank sowie relevanter regulatorischer nationaler und internationaler Themen (z. B. CRD VI, MiFID II, FIDLEG, GWG)

• Spezifische Fachkenntnisse in operationellen Risiken, Key Risk Indikatoren, Risk- & Control Self-Assessment sowie Testing und Dokumentation von Kontrollen

• Proaktive, belastbare, selbstbewusste Persönlichkeit mit analytischer, pragmatischer und ergebnisorientierter Denkweise sowie ausgeprägter Change- und Development-Mentalität

Was wir bieten:

• Ein fachlich anspruchsvolles und zukunftorientiertes Arbeitsumfeld mit komplexen Fragestellungen, moderner Technologie und starken Innovationsfokus

• Ein dynamisches, internationales Umfeld mit Gestaltungsspielraum, das Flexibilität erfordert und gleichzeitig klare langfristige Ziele verfolgt

• Die Möglichkeit, End-to-End-Perspektiven auf das Client Management zu gewinnen und Prozesse sowie Governance aktiv mitzugestalten

• Hohe Eigenverantwortung, Sichtbarkeit und zahlreiche Chancen zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung,

Wir suchen nach talentierten Menschen und nicht nur nach einem Lebenslauf, der alle Kriterien erfüllt. Auch wenn du nicht alles mitbringst, was wir von dir verlangen, solltest du dich bewerben.

Bei Vontobel arbeitest du an einer besseren Zukunft für unsere Kunden, die Gesellschaft und dich selbst. Wir beschäftigen mehr als 2.300 Mitarbeitende an über 25 Standorten weltweit und haben unseren Hauptsitz in Zürich.
Wir befinden uns mehrheitlich in Familienbesitz und sind börsenkotiert. Unsere Fähigkeit, uns langfristig auf Themen wie Nachhaltigkeit zu konzentrieren, wird durch die Sicherheit des 100-jährigen Engagements der Familie untermauert. Wir suchen diverse Talente, die in einer sich wandelnden Welt etwas bewegen wollen und die aus den unterschiedlichsten Bereichen kommen.

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Stiamo cercando una personalità impegnata, analitica e orientata al design che svilupperà attivamente il futuro della gestione transfrontaliera insieme a noi. Se vuoi assumerti la responsabilità, strutturare problemi complessi e ottenere un impatto reale in un ambiente internazionale, sei nel posto giusto!

Quali sono i vostri compiti:

• Garantire e sviluppare continuamente un quadro transfrontaliero olistico ed efficace (compresi i metodi, i processi e la reportistica, utilizzando l'automazione mirata e le tecnologie AI)

• Responsabilità per la pianificazione, il coordinamento e l'attuazione di progetti transfrontalieri impegnativi con elevata visibilità

• Ufficio centrale per le questioni transfrontaliere: consulenza, coordinamento e stretta collaborazione con Relationship Manager, partner risparmiatore per i capi di mercato e senior management

• Analisi, sviluppo e sviluppo di linee direttrici, basi decisionali e relazioni che coinvolgono strumenti di analisi e di reporting supportati dall'IA

• Co-design attivo e ulteriore sviluppo della governance transfrontaliera, dei modelli di processo e operativi

• Sostegno alla cooperazione e ai contenuti negli audit interni e negli audit normativi

Cosa ci aspettiamo?

• Università o università completa di scienze applicate (economia, diritto, finanza o simili)

• Diversi anni di esperienza professionale nel campo del transfrontaliero nell'industria finanziaria, obbligatoria nella "Prima linea di difesa" nell'ambiente privato cliente, la consulenza è un plus

• Conoscenza approfondita del progetto e della gestione delle parti interessate combinata con eccellenti competenze di comunicazione in tedesco e inglese

• Ottima conoscenza dei processi di base (fronte) di una banca, nonché dei relativi argomenti normativi nazionali e internazionali (ad esempio CRD VI, MiFID II, FIDLEG, GWG)

• Competenze specifiche nei rischi operativi, indicatori chiave di rischio, autovalutazione del rischio e del controllo, nonché test e documentazione dei controlli

• Proattiva, resiliente, personalità autoconfidente con una mentalità analitica, pragmatica e orientata al risultato, nonché una mentalità di cambiamento e sviluppo pronunciata

Cosa offriamo:

• Un ambiente di lavoro tecnicamente impegnativo e orientato al futuro con questioni complesse, tecnologia moderna e un forte focus sull'innovazione

• Un ambiente dinamico e internazionale con spazio di manovra che richiede flessibilità nel perseguire obiettivi a lungo termine chiari

• L'opportunità di ottenere prospettive end-to-end sulla gestione del cliente e modellare attivamente i processi e la governance

• Alta responsabilità personale, visibilità e numerose opportunità di sviluppo professionale e personale,

Stiamo cercando persone di talento e non solo un CV che soddisfa tutti i criteri. Anche se non porti tutto quello che ti chiediamo, dovresti applicare.

A Vontobel, stai lavorando ad un futuro migliore per i nostri clienti, la società e te stesso. Usiamo più di 2.300 persone in più di 25 sedi in tutto il mondo e abbiamo la nostra sede a Zurigo.
Siamo per lo più di proprietà della famiglia e quotati sulla borsa. La nostra capacità di concentrarsi su questioni come la sostenibilità a lungo termine è sostenuta dalla sicurezza dell’impegno di 100 anni della famiglia. Siamo alla ricerca di diversi talenti che vogliono fare la differenza in un mondo mutevole e che provengono da una vasta gamma di campi.

Grazie per aver fatto domanda a Vontobel. Noi esamineremo attentamente la vostra applicazione e vi risponderemo in modo tempestivo.

A Vontobel, siamo un posto di lavoro pari opportunità. Ci impegniamo a pari opportunità di lavoro indipendentemente da razza, colore, antenati, religione, sesso, origine nazionale, orientamento sessuale, età, cittadinanza, stato civile, disabilità o identità di genere.
Valiamo l'uomo
descriptionByLocale.en:
We are looking for a committed, analytical and design-oriented personality who will actively develop the future of cross-border management together with us. If you would like to take on responsibility, structure complex issues and achieve real impact in an international environment, you are in the right place!

What are your tasks:

• Ensuring and continuously developing a holistic, effective cross-border framework (including methods, processes and reporting, using targeted automation and AI technologies)

• Responsibility for planning, coordinating and implementing challenging cross-border projects with high visibility

• Central office for cross-border issues: consulting, coordination and close cooperation with Relationship Manager, sparring partner for market heads and senior management

• Analysis, development and further development of cross-border relevant guidelines, decision-making bases and reports involving AI-supported analysis and reporting tools

• Active co-design and further development of cross-border governance, process and operating models

• Cooperation and content support in internal audits and regulatory audits

What do we expect?

• Completed university or university of applied sciences (economics, law, finance or similar)

• Several years of professional experience in the field of cross-border in the financial industry, mandatory in the "First Line of Defense" in the private client environment, consulting experience is a plus

• In-depth knowledge of project and stakeholder management combined with excellent communication skills in German and English

• Very good knowledge of the (front) core processes of a bank as well as relevant regulatory national and international topics (e.g. CRD VI, MiFID II, FIDLEG, GWG)

• Specific expertise in operational risks, key risk indicators, risk & control self-assessment as well as testing and documentation of controls

• Proactive, resilient, self-confident personality with an analytical, pragmatic and result-oriented mindset as well as a pronounced change and development mentality

What we offer:

• A technically challenging and future-oriented working environment with complex issues, modern technology and a strong focus on innovation

• A dynamic, international environment with room for manoeuvre that requires flexibility while pursuing clear long-term goals

• The opportunity to gain end-to-end perspectives on client management and actively shape processes and governance

• High personal responsibility, visibility and numerous opportunities for professional and personal development,

We are looking for talented people and not just a CV that meets all the criteria. Even if you don’t bring everything we ask of you, you should apply.

At Vontobel, you are working on a better future for our customers, society and yourself. We employ more than 2,300 people at more than 25 locations worldwide and have our headquarters in Zurich.
We are mostly family owned and listed on the stock exchange. Our ability to focus on issues such as sustainability in the long term is underpinned by the safety of the family’s 100-year commitment. We are looking for diverse talents who want to make a difference in a changing world and who come from a wide range of fields.

Thank you for applying to Vontobel. We will carefully review your application and will respond to you in a timely manner.

At Vontobel, we are an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity.
We value the man

jobs.title: Investment Risk Manager
jobs.description:
At Vontobel, we are committed to actively shaping our future. We strive to engage and promote talent of varying age and gender, with a diverse range of experience, from various backgrounds.

We create and pursue investment opportunities that get our clients ahead. As a global investment manager, we believe in high conviction asset management and investment solutions. With portfolio management teams in New York, London and Zurich, Vontobel Asset Management is a specialized investment manager with a multi-boutique approach and a track record of strong and consistent growth. We focus on Equities, Fixed Income, Multi Asset Class, and Alternative Investing, actively managing over CHF 100bn of assets on behalf of institutional and intermediary clients globally.

Our Investment Risk Team measures, assesses and challenges all investment-related risks (e.g. market, credit and counterparty, liquidity, ESG) in our actively managed investment portfolios and monitors implementation of mitigation measures. The team also plays an active role to support and shape the Risk Infrastructure landscape.

In this important role you will focus on independent risk analysis, assessment and when needed escalation relating to actively managed investment products across all boutiques. The function’s stakeholders are the firm’s senior management and investment teams.

The role will be based in Zurich.

What would your role be?

• Identify, assess, measure, monitor, mitigate and report on market, liquidity, credit, counterparty and sustainability risks across multiple asset classes and investment structures.

• Provide an independent view of investment risk profiles to investment teams, deploying quantitative tools such factor risk decomposition, scenario simulations and other stress tests.

• Agree appropriate investment risk measures to be monitored and reviewed as appropriate, and escalate issues where required.

• Organise and manage formal risk reviews with investment teams.

• Contribute to interactions with internal and external stakeholders, e.g. clients, auditors, in the capacity of subject matter expert on investment risk management.

• Be a contributor to the different Governance Bodies, such as Investment Performance Committee and other executive committees.

• Collaborate as required with other Risk functions within Vontobel, including Operational Risk, Investment Control, Compliance and Management Company risk teams.

• Support the Head of Investment Risk in developing and maintaining an adequate risk management framework and infrastructure that maximise efficiency whilst ensuring completeness and effectiveness. Also ensuring that best practice risk governance is in place and followed and fostering a positive risk culture across the firm.

What are we looking for?

• Industry experience: at least 5 years’ experience in an investment risk management or portfolio management role, preferably in an asset management firm.

• Quantitative and/or quantitative finance related education: a first degree in a strongly quantitative subject, such as engineering, physics or applied mathematics or an education in economics or finance. A CFA, FRM or other industry qualification would be an advantage.

• Asset class and financial instrument knowledge: a strong base in at least one of fixed-income (rates and credit) and equities asset classes, with a good understanding of FX and multi-asset investing, and an all-round understanding of risks and pricing of derivative instruments.

• Quantitative and programming skills: experience of deploying databases and programming languages to manage, analyse and interpret data. (e.g. SQL, Python, R, Matlab)

• Specific subject knowledge: multi-factor market risk modelling, liquidity risk modelling and concepts of counterparty risk.

• First-hand experience of risk systems (e.g. MSCI BarraOne, MSCI RiskMetrics, Bloomberg Enterprise)

• Regulatory knowledge: experience of the Swiss and Luxembourg regulatory framework for inve
